text:
Echo State Networks (ESNs) are a type of recurrent neural network used for processing time-series data. They consist of a large, fixed set of nodes (the reservoir) that are randomly connected and have their weights set during training. The weights of the output layer are then trained to map the reservoir's state to the desired output. Training typically involves a simple linear regression on the reservoir's state to predict the next state or output.
